column1: Whisk the flour, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl.
Beat the butter on high for 1 minute, then add the brown sugar and 1/4 cup granulated sugar and beat about 2 minutes until smooth.
Beat in the egg, then the peanut butter and vanilla.
Mix in the flour mixture on low until combined.
Cover and chill the soft dough for at least 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (177°C), line two baking sheets, and clear space in the freezer.
Roll heaping tablespoons of dough into balls, coat in the sugar, and space 3 inches apart.
Bake 11–13 minutes until the tops just start to crack, then cool 5 minutes on the sheets.
Press a chocolate kiss into each cookie and gently transfer them to plates.
Freeze the cookies for 10 minutes to set the chocolate before serving.
